thread:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout for release v2.14.3 -> prod. Canary 5% now (20:12 UTC). deploy-id: dpl-2026-03-20-17. Watch SLO dashboards: https://dash.redwood/s/v2-14-3 :rocket:
ryan-oncall: seeing p95 jump on text-gen route from ~210ms -> ~460ms in the last 90s. Repro on canary nodes only :eyes:
ashley-sre: alert fired: SLO p95 > 400ms for 2m on route /api/v1/generate, incident id inc-4021. Tagging SRE responders :warning:
sara-release: pausing further ramp immediately. @deploy-bot hold traffic shift, do not increase beyond 5% until we triage.
mike-runtime: grabbing canary logs now. Early suspicion: quantized kernel fallback for large prompts causing stall. Not seeing CPU/GPU throttles. KV cache misses up on canary by ~12%.
evans-product: any user-facing errors? error-rate (5xx) still low, mostly latency. But a couple of timeouts in customer heartbeat checks.
ryan-oncall: posting quick trace snippets: ```
TraceID: abcd-1234
span: model_infer -> 0.34s
span: kv_cache_lookup -> 0.18s (miss)
span: kernel_fallback -> 0.48s
```
ashley-sre: recommend blocking further traffic and pin to previous revision if we can't mitigate in 10m. Current canary SLO breach window > 2m.
sara-release: agree. We need an explicit rollback or pin decision. What's recovery ETA if we pin? :thinking_face:
mike-runtime: pin to v2.14.2 on the canary routing table will route canary traffic to known-good binary instantly. Command: ``deployctl pin-route --route text-gen --to v2.14.2 --deploy-id dpl-2026-03-20-17``
infra-bot: Pin request queued. Estimated propagation 45s.
evans-product: fine from product side. Notify support and mark release notes hold.
ryan-oncall: also enabling a temporary routing fallback to dedicated-pool B if pin doesn't drop latency: `routectl move --route text-gen --to dedicated-pool-b --weight 5%`
sara-release: do the pin + fallback plan. I'll hold the ramp and update release board. Can we get a short blameless postmort later if this is rollout-specific?
mike-runtime: executed pin. Logs: ``INFO: routing: pinned text-gen -> v2.14.2 (deployctl#123)``
infra-bot: Pin applied. Canary traffic still at 5% but now hitting v2.14.2.
ryan-oncall: p95 dropping - now 220ms and falling back to baseline in the last 60s. Good sign. :thumbsup:
ashley-sre: closing SLO incident. Marking inc-4021 as mitigated. Will keep monitors at 1x sensitivity for 20m.
sara-release: status update for release notes: "v2.14.3 canary paused due to elevated latency on text-gen; pinned canary to v2.14.2 and holding rollout until runtime team verifies kernel fallback behavior."
evans-product: OK to reschedule full rollout after runtime fixes. Send a short note to beta customers impacted.
mike-runtime: next steps: collect kernel traces, reproduce locally w/ quantized model, try fallback tweak (hotfix PR incoming).
sara-release: thanks team. Temporary hold remains. If latency stable for 30m we can re-evaluate small ramp. Otherwise rollback full release.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused per request. Action log: {action: pin, target: v2.14.2, actor: mike-runtime, time: 2018456820}. Will not increase traffic until manual resume. :lock:
notes: Canary pause + pin; SLO alert inc-4021; routing pin applied; follow-up kernel fix planned
